📌 [...] Hey Product Hunt! 👋  
  
DeployHermes lets you spin up your own private, always-on Hermes agent for Telegram/Discord in under a minute.  
We built it because getting Hermes live today still means dealing with servers, Docker, Fly.io, environment variables, and a lot of setup friction before you ever get to the fun part: actually using your agent. That works for technical users, but it blocks a much bigger group of people who just want their own agent running reliably.  
  
With DeployHermes, you bring your own model keys, connect your Telegram bot, and launch a dedicated Hermes runtime with persistent memory and encrypted secrets. The goal is simple: your agent should feel personal and always available, without you needing to operate infrastructure.

I built this because most ad surfaces feel abstract and forgettable. I wanted something that makes attention tangible: a real key on a real keyboard, visible pricing, and an obvious redirect when it’s live.  
  
You choose a key, set the duration, add your URL, and once the slot is active that key sends traffic to your page. Dynamic pricing and add-ons make the marketplace feel alive instead of static.

results.title: Clawdi: Best home for all AI agents | Product Hunt
results.content:
The part that shaped how we positioned the product: I kept telling the team that the setup was the wall. Not the concept, not the price but the setup. Every non-technical person I showed OpenClaw to bounced at the same point. Clawdi is the answer to that. The 3-minute deployment is NOT a marketing line, it’s the actual fix. With Clawdi integration, the deployment of Hermes agent got even sweeter: Now it doesn’t just do tasks across apps, it learns from every run and gets better over time.

If you work in marketing, ops, or anything that involves a lot of tabs and repetitive tasks, and you’ve already tried OpenClaw and given up, Clawdi is worth another look.

results.title: Cloudways by DigitalOcean: Intelligent managed hosting with AI-powered insights. | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hey Product Hunt 👋  
  
We're the team behind Cloudways, managing 600K+ servers and 1M+ apps for agencies and developers worldwide.  
  
Here's what we kept hearing: OpenClaw and Hermes are great agents. Setup takes hours, and the real problem shows up after day one. Keeping an agent running 24/7 means managing patches, updates, and monitoring, or it stops working. That's a hosting problem that prevents users from using OpenClaw and Hermes for real-world workloads.  
  
So we built Cloudways Managed AI Agents. Pick OpenClaw or Hermes, connect your own LLM key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, or DigitalOcean, and deploy on an isolated instance with managed security patching and Cloudways-validated updates.
